name: The Dusk
source:
After years of forgetting, life begins to twist in strange ways. A ghost appears, a death remains unexplained, and the pieces of a long-buried mystery await your discovery.

[From [url=https://3sleepless.itch.io/the-dusk]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
经过多年的遗忘，生活开始以奇怪的方式扭曲。鬼魂出现，死亡原因不明，埋藏已久的谜团的碎片等待着你的发现。

[来自[url=https://3sleepless.itch.io/the-dusk]Itch.io[/url]]
